spec.query: SELECT "pre_fill_unix_ns"/1000000 AS "pre_fill_unix_ms", "contract_error", "is_jito", "is_buy", "block_number_pre_fill" AS "pre fill block", "tx_block", "fill_delay_blocks" AS "fill_delay", "sim_slot", "expected_spread_bps" AS "exp spread bp", "realized_spread_bps" AS "rlzd spread bp", "lot_size_usd", "fill_size_usd", "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp fill pnl", "tip_amount_usd" AS "tip usd", "bundle_id", "dex", "pool", "base_asset_variant" AS "base", "quote_asset_variant" AS "quote", "gas_actual_fee_usd" AS "gas usd", "is_cefi_trigger" AS "cefi trig", "is_defi_trigger" AS "defi trig", "edge_bps","rejected_reason" AS "reject reason", "in_soft_timeout", "timeout", "commitment", "receipt_timeout", "jito_broadcast_error", "rpc_broadcast_error", "version", "time_since_latest_block_pre_fill_micros"  / 1000 AS "ms since block", "block_adjustment_bps_pre_fill" AS "block adj bp", "ema_adjustment_bps_pre_fill" AS "ema adj bp", "gas_usage_pct", "tx_hash"  FROM "default_defi_retention"."solana_defi_cefi_arb_post_fill" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "is_jito"::tag =~ /^$is_jito$/ AND "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$defi_trig$/) AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1000000

spec.query: SELECT median("defi_base_balance_whole_pre_fill") FROM "default_defi_retention"."rust_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "base_asset"::tag =~ /^$asset$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "pool"::tag fill(previous)

SELECT median("positionAsFloat") * (median("bid") + median("ask"))/2
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE ("strategy"::tag =~ /^$placement$/)
AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(10s) 
fill(previous)
